title: mosaik smart-grid demo with ontology export

sources.title: User-supplied mosaik-scenario-planning.zip
sources.note: The source identifier records the ZIP SHA-256. Upstream repository and commit are unresolved.

limitations: Key modules/ontologies referenced (cosicoca ontology contents, information_model.owl, sparql_handler internals, export_handler internals, validation_handler internals) are not present in supplied artifacts; this prevents verifying semantic matching and validation logic.

Time-series input files referenced (pv_10kw.csv, profiles.data.gz) are named but their contents were not supplied for inspection (only referenced paths exist); exact sampling/format cannot be verified here.

The supplied code exports scenario RDF without necessarily executing the simulation (demo_eval may be run with run=False); it is unclear from supplied artifacts whether exported RDF includes runtime traces or only static scenario definitions.

findings.claim: The repository implements ontology-based scenario planning: IM -> CoSiCoCa -> mosaik scenario export -> validation (dissertation workflow).
findings.explanation: README explicitly describes the dissertation workflow chaining Information Model, CoSiCoCa, mosaik scenario export and validation.

findings.claim: Demo uses PyPower (grid), HouseholdSim (households), CSV adapter (PV time series) and mosaik-hdf5 (database recorder).
findings.explanation: SIM_CONFIG lists adapters and create_scenario starts PyPower, HouseholdSim, CSV and a DB recorder; code instantiates grid, houses, PVs and HDF5 recorder.

findings.claim: Houses connect to grid nodes mapping 'P_out' -> 'P'; PVs connect to node 'P'; node/branch variables (P,Q,Vl,Vm,Va,P_from,Q_from,P_to,Q_to) are written to HDF5.
findings.explanation: connect_buildings_to_grid connects house P_out to bus P (Ln205–211); connect_randomly connects PVs to node 'P' (Ln121–123). Many-to-one connections to HDF5 list the attributes recorded (Ln125–136).

findings.claim: The catalogue asserts ontology-driven matching and unit/time-scale checking, but the referenced ontology files and SPARQL handler logic are not supplied for verification.
findings.explanation: diss_process.py calls CosicocaHandler and SPARQLHandler and appends cosicoca.onto to IM (Ln50–56) and later runs components_from_cosicoca and find_suitable_components_for_im (Ln56–75), but the implementations and the actual ontology files are not present in supplied artifacts.
findings.recommended_correction: Mark catalogue fields that claim detailed SPARQL/unit/dimension validation as 'requires verification' and link to actual ontology/rule sources; or supply sparql_handler.py and the Ontology RDF files so claims can be confirmed.

findings.claim: Exported RDF contains runtime traces (time series) from an executed simulation run.
findings.explanation: demo_eval exports scenario RDF (Ln76–80). However, diss_process calls demo_eval.main(..., run=False) (A3:Ln86–87), meaning RDF exported there is produced without running the simulation. There is no supplied evidence that exported RDF includes runtime-recorded time series.
findings.recommended_correction: Update catalogue to distinguish 'static scenario export' (structure & metadata) from 'runtime trace export' and mark the latter as unverified until a run=True export and its RDF contents are provided.

findings.claim: DFG workflow uses the XMind workbook xmind/20201120_Integrated_InformationModel.xmind to build the Information Model.
findings.explanation: xmind_im_export_dfg.config points to the XMind workbook (Ln6–9) and dfg_process.py documents reading from it (Ln103–117), but the workbook file itself is not present among supplied artifacts. Thus the exact IM content used by the DFG process cannot be inspected.
findings.recommended_correction: Record in the catalogue that the XMind workbook is missing and either supply it or mark derived IM outputs as unverifiable.

findings.claim: Matched components from CoSiCoCa are automatically added to the mosaik scenario during diss_process.
findings.explanation: diss_process obtains chosen_inputs/chosen_outputs via find_suitable_components_for_im (Ln73–75) but only instantiates MosaikScenarioHandler.add_models if choose_option is not False (Ln76–82). In the provided script choose_option is set to False (Ln70–71), so automatic addition is skipped. The catalogue should not assert automatic instantiation here without noting the conditional.
findings.recommended_correction: Correct catalogue to state that component addition is conditional; note that in the supplied orchestration the add_models path is not executed (choose_option=False).

findings.claim: Is the exported scenario RDF intended to include runtime series (if so, which export step), or only the structural scenario?
findings.explanation: Code paths show both possibilities: demo_eval can run simulation (run=True) and then exports, while diss_process explicitly calls demo_eval with run=False before validation (A2:Ln86–87; A3:Ln86–87). The supplied artifacts do not clarify the intended semantics of the exported RDF in each workflow.
findings.recommended_correction: Catalogue should record this question and request clarification or an example exported RDF showing runtime traces (if intended).
